newsitem.title: USA: Dow retreats after brief bounce, NYSE re-sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow retreats after brief bounce, NYSE re-sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips settled back to lower levels as program trading began to buffet the Dow late in the session.
The Dow fell 58 points to 6734, prompting the NYSE to re-impose index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1526 EDT/1926 GMT, just 24 minutes after the exchange had lifted the curbs.
Birinyi Associates said a late sell program contributed to blue chips' late decline but the firm could not yet offer details on the impact of the program.
